description: Lookups and availability stay free. Each agent identity gets 25 free sends per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs $0.25 and a confirmed booking $1.00, from prepaid Direct credit. Top up $10 or $50; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Send take_message, check_availability, book or book_first_available. Keep message_id unchanged on retry. Use target=claim for verified listings. Booking requires the human’s permission; pending deposits are charged only after calendar confirmation.
